description: Reject the artefact under review. The task is declined, or returns to in_progress if request_revision is set.

approved_artefact_digest.description: Optional. SHA-256 over the JCS canonicalisation of the artefact under review, in the form `sha256:<hex>`. When present it binds the decision to the exact content reviewed, and a mismatch is refused with -32074.

comment.description: The reviewer's note on this decision. Recorded in the audit entry for the decision.

request_revision.description: When true the task returns to 'in_progress' rather than 'declined', so the assignee can revise and resubmit.

tags.description: Workspace-defined labels for this decision, e.g. ['tone', 'unsupported-claim']. Recorded in the audit entry. chap.audit.read does not filter on tags, so grouping by tag is done by the reader.

name: chap.decide.reject
title: chap.decide.reject
